name: Harness Tool Pipeline
description: Tool call pipeline: Hook → Permission (Gene.tool_policy) → Timeout → Execute → ResultRewrite (redact secrets/US IPs) → Emit. Implements Gene gene_harness_tool_call_pipeline.

forbiddenPaths.description: Hard-coded forbidden paths (美机 /opt/goapi, etc). Default: builtin list.

redactPatterns.description: Regex patterns to redact from tool output. Default: ['Red\d{6,}', '47\.89\.\d+\.\d+', 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}', 'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}']

emitterBin.description: Path to event_emitter.py (from harness-event-stream plugin). Default: ~/.openclaw/workspace/devagent/openclaw-harness/bin
